profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Geographic Solutions, Inc.
profile.summary: Certified Senior .NET Developer with 14 years of experience, specialized in front-end and back-end development. Experienced in various software development methodologies, with active involvement in all stages of the development cycle for web and desktop projects. Strong background in architecture and design patterns. Team player with excellent troubleshooting response and great aptitude for all types of progressive solutions.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.locationName: Syracuse y alrededores, Nueva York, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Design, develop and maintain a set of e-learning platforms for an important Department of Defense contractor. Those platforms are mainly used by soldiers from Special Troops and the Air Force to learn languages. There are more than 100 languages and using the latest state of the art in teaching languages, classes can be taught in real time. Since classes are not recorded, the teachers and students can interact through the webcam and microphone and the chat system.
Achievement Highlights:
• Design and develop a complex communication system to improve the interaction between the students and teachers during classes. This system includes a chat and a forum; and it was created using SignalR, which is one of the most advanced real-time technologies. The system is also used in Helpdesk support.
• Design and develop an e-learning platform (for Chinese students who wish to enter American universities) to help them prepare for college life, selecting the right university, preparing them for standardized tests, teaching them how to write essays, completing applications, etc. .

positions.title: Team Leader/Analyst/Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Team leader in charge of a multidisciplinary team of eight people, composed of mathematicians, programmers and designers. Design and develop object-oriented modular-software for one of the electronic commerce platform industry leading in Russia.  

Achievement Highlights:
Design and development of a complex system of crawlers, responsible for gathering financial information across Internet 
Design and development of a complex data-mining system, responsible for extracting relevant financial information from the huge amount of data found formerly by crawlers
Design and development of a financial-analytical system, responsible for allow to the final user the financial information analysis. 
Design and development of the electronic commerce system front-end in several platforms as: desktop, web and mobile.
Design and develop a multi-threading analytical system in CUDA for .NET (CUDAFY), which notoriously increase speed up 100 fold, compared with the previous existing system.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Teach training courses on .NET for non-specialized programmers. Development and design of an ERP system for an important company in the sector.

Achievement Highlights:
Increase the prestige of the consultancy, by giving quality courses of .NET to a large number of interested programmers
Significant increase in sales in the company, for the design and development of a large, complex and expensive ERP system on .NET, for a prestigious company in the communications sector

positions.title: Analyst, .NET Developer
positions.description:
Design and development of an automatic translator

Achievement Highlights:
Develop a rule-based automatic translator using artificial intelligence technologies (Prolog), for be applied in automatic translation of websites.
